# Support

Need a hand? Here's where to go 👇

## Before you ask

Have a look at the [README](./README.md), especially [Usage](./README.md#usage), and the note on the app's deploy form. Then search [existing issues](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/portainer-templates-extras/issues?q=is%3Aissue), because someone's likely hit the same thing.

---

## Where to ask

| I want to... | Go here |
| ------------ | ------- |
| Ask a question or share an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/portainer-templates-extras/discussions) |
| Report a broken template | [Bug report](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/portainer-templates-extras/issues/new?template=broken_template.yml) |
| Request an app | [App request](https://github.com/NotAFlightRisk/portainer-templates-extras/issues/new?template=request_app.yml) |
| Report a vulnerability | [Security policy](./SECURITY.md) - **not** a public issue |
| Contribute a change | [Contributing guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md) |

---

## Expectations

This is open source, maintained in spare time, so there's no guaranteed response time. Clear, reproducible reports with all the details I'll need are the ones that get sorted quickest.
